captions.detailed: A standalone garden bell post featuring a tall, dark-colored square steel support post with a horizontal cross-arm and diagonal brace near the top. Hanging from the cross-arm is a bronze-colored bell attached via a clevis bracket. The bell swings on a horizontal revolute joint, and a small pull-cord clapper lever is situated inside the bell on a secondary revolute pin to allow realistic ringing motion.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an outdoor garden bell post using CadQuery. The design should feature a tall, dark square steel post with a horizontal cross-arm, a bronze-colored bell suspended from a clevis mount on a revolute joint, and an articulated internal clapper lever.
captions.factory: Construct the main vertical post and horizontal cross-arm using square box primitives, adding a diagonal structural brace. Model the bell body using a combination of cylinder and lofted or revolved profiles, assigned a bronze material. Define a primary revolute joint linking the bell assembly to the cross-arm clevis, and a secondary revolute joint inside the bell to mount the clapper lever.
